column1: # Pinned item/action and Check-message grammars: key, exact regex, Java Pattern flags.

column2: ^Your Trident of the (seas|swamp)( \(e\))? has (?:((?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)) charges|(one) charge|(no) charges)\.$

^(?:Your )?(Holy sanguinesti staff|Sanguinesti staff|warped sceptre|Tumeken's shadow|echo venator bow|venator bow)(?: only)? has (?:((?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)) charges?|(one) charge|(no) charges?)(?: (?:remaining|left))?\.$
^(?:Your tome has been charged with (?:Burnt|Searing) Pages\. It currently holds|Your tome currently holds) (?:([\d,]+)|(one)) charges?\.$
^Your (crystal bow|crystal halberd|bow of Faerdhinen) has (?:([\d,]+)|(one)) charges? remaining\.$
^Your Amulet of blood fury will work for ((\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)) more hits?\.$
^The Eye of Ayak has been charged with demon tears\. It currently has ((\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)) charges?\.$
^The Eye of Ayak has been charged with runes\. It currently has ((\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)) charges?\.$

column1: # A treasure trail's scrolls, boxes and caskets are claims on the casket's loot, held at zero.

column2: ^(?:clue scroll|scroll box|challenge scroll|reward casket|clue bottle|clue nest|clue geode) \((?:beginner|easy|medium|hard|elite|master)\)|puzzle box|light box$
^Payment has been taken from your bank: ([\d,]+) (?:x Coins|coins)\.?$

^Your (?:bow|sceptre|chainmace) has (?:([\d,]+) charges?|(one) charge|no charges) left powering it\.$
